name: speech-to-text-api
description: A speech-to-text api for the companion UI

scripts.build: tsc -p src/tsconfig.json && pnpm copy:bin && pnpm copy:scripts && mkdir -p tmp
scripts.dev: pnpm cleanup && pnpm format && pnpm build && node dist/index.js
scripts.cleanup: rm -rf podcast.mp3 podcast.mp4 podcast.srt podcast.webvtt podcast.jpg podcast_transcribed.mp4 segments tmp/*.mp3
